body:
Closes two of the three real gaps apps/dynmod_poc's own proof-of-concept still named: no manifest format apps/server itself understands, and no designed error-handling policy for a bad/missing mod at real server startup. New optional --mods-manifest flag, default unset (zero behavior change unless given). When given, reads a real manifest at startup (so_path|function-name per line, simpler than dynmod_poc's own test-oriented format since a running server has no expected value to self-check), dlopens every distinct .so exactly once and dlsyms every listed function into a small in-memory registry (g_mod_registry). Real, considered error-handling policy: a bad mod (missing .so, missing symbol, malformed line) is logged as a WARNING and skipped, never fatal to the server. New apps/server/testdata/mods_manifest.example.txt. apps/server/BUILD.bazel: added -ldl. Verified live, fully clean (bazel clean, then a plain build/test, no special flags): 23 targets, 8/8 mod tests pass. Real throwaway server instance testing (real GoblinFoxDragon worldapi on :7070, isolated save/world/damage paths, cleaned up after): a real 4-line manifest registers all 4 functions across 3 distinct .so files and the server serves normally afterward; a real deliberately-broken manifest logs 3 WARNINGs, still registers the 2 good mods, and the server stays alive and serving; no --mods-manifest flag at all produces byte-for-byte the same startup log as before this change. MODDING.md and NORTHSTAR.md updated. One real remaining gap: an actual apps/server call site using a dynamically-loaded function instead of a statically-linked one -- a real, separate design question (fallback behavior if a mod fails to load), not attempted here. Commits: 3645287 (PAPERCRAFT), 5d4354b (PAPERCRAFT changelog).

⚓ ☃
title: S206-29: wire the dlopen mod-loading mechanism into apps/server
